description:
TL;DR: VinylCrafts creates special vinyl record frames and shelves from certified wood, all handcrafted in the Netherlands. We're expanding across Europe and would love to partner with affiliates passionate about vinyl and interior design. Find out more about us, our brand, and products below!

About VinylCrafts

Welcome to VinylCrafts – the venture of Jens and Melvin, two Dutch entrepreneurs combining their love for music and design. Our brand is all about blending music with home decor, perfect for music fans and vinyl collectors. We believe music should be visible in your home, not just heard.

Our products are made with care from wood in social workshops in the Netherlands, reflecting our commitment to craftsmanship and quality.

We're now aiming to grow VinylCrafts across Europe and are on the lookout for affiliates who are as excited about our vision as we are. With your support, we can bring the beauty of vinyl into more homes. Jens and Melvin invite you to join us on this exciting journey.

Our Products

We create vinyl record frames, shelves, and holders, mainly focusing on wall decor. Our items are made from certified wood and are available in three finishes: natural oak, lacquered black, and dark walnut.

Brand USPs

All our products are made in Europe, specifically in a social workshop in the Netherlands. We partner with OneTreePlanted, planting a new tree for every order, ensuring we add more trees than we use. Our packaging and production processes are plastic-free and 100% renewable.

Conditions and Payment

Since 2024, we're focusing on Europe and looking for enthusiastic affiliates who are vinyl collectors with an eye for interior design. If you have a following of 15k+, we'd be thrilled to offer you a set of our products at a 50% discount. Specifically Germany and Belgium have our focus interest.  Expansion to North America will be planned once at least Germany, Belgium, France and Denmark have seriously been committed. One step at the time.. ;) 

Affiliates will get a 10% commission on the total order value before shipping and taxes. Our vinylrecord frames have an higher 12% commission, as this product specifically makes us unique. Payments are made via PayPal or bank deposit. If you'd prefer a different arrangement, please reach out to us!

Why not sign up yet?

If you have any questions, let us know. We're keen to have every vinyl collector on our team!
